text: Baron Blitzkrieg is a supervillain appearing in American comic books published by DC Comics. The character, also known as Baron Reiter and simply the Baron, was created by Gerry Conway and Don Heck and first appeared in World's Finest Comics #246 (September 1977). Originally a vicious German army officer during World War II, Baron Reiter was blinded and disfigured when a concentration camp prisoner threw a bottle in his face. German scientists experimented on him as a Nazi, restoring his sight but not his appearance. As a result, he gains superhuman strength, invulnerability, optical energy beams, and the ability to fly. Initially, he could manifest these abilities one at a time, but underwent training to use them together. His early appearances were primarily antagonistic encounters with Wonder Woman and Superman. He later became a frequent opponent of the All-Star Squadron, brainwashed Commander Steel, confronted Hourman resulting in Red Bee's death, conspired with Zyklon to use the Liberty Bell to destroy Philadelphia before being defeated by the original Liberty Belle, Johnny Quick, and Jay Garrick / Flash, tried to stay hidden in Jamaica, and served as a benefactor of Axis Amerika. The Baron leads Shadowspire and collaborates with Vandal Savage's Symbolix organization in experimental research on Damage and an assassination attempt that is foiled by Deathstroke. During the "Infinite Crisis" storyline, he joins the Secret Society of Super Villains and is killed by Superboy-Prime during the Battle of Metropolis. In the "Blackest Night" storyline, his corpse is entombed below the Hall of Justice and later revived as a Black Lantern. In a flashback from JSA (vol. 2), during the 1940s, he led Gudra the Valkyrie, Horned Owl, Zyklon, and Nazi soldiers in an attempt to steal the Spear of Destiny, which was thwarted by the Justice Society of America and the Blackhawks. He possesses enhanced strength, agility, and endurance, wears body armor that provides some protection from physical attacks, has heat vision, and the ability to fly, and can travel between Earth-2 and Earth-X. In the alternate Flashpoint timeline, he makes a minor appearance and is killed by Frankenstein.
